result:
The proposed solution does not establish its claim, and I believe 15 is wrong, though I did not derive the correct maximum.

- The argument that the symmetry algebra is 8 right-invariant fields plus a 7-dimensional automorphism algebra is unjustified. The automorphisms of 𝔫 that preserve V must also preserve all the brackets. The solution takes a block-triangular matrix space (with zeros in the bottom row) and does not impose the bracket-preserving conditions, so the 7 is not a computed dimension.
- The claim that "the automorphism group of the symbol is at most 7-dimensional" is asserted without proof.
- The step "a direct product of the nilpotent part with this automorphism group gives the full Tanaka prolongation" is also unsupported. A Tanaka prolongation need not have this form, and it is not computed here.
- The chosen algebra is just one example, and nothing shows it is maximal. A real answer needs the Tanaka prolongation of the symbol, or the known classification of growth (3,6,8) distributions.

My recollection of the literature is that the true maximum differs from 15, but I am not certain of that.

VERDICT: REJECT
